notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Triskelion.
Triskelion has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Druid's Call triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Repeat.
During the next player's turn, you may remove all of the +1/+1 counters from Triskelion to deal infinite damage to any target(s).
